segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's sort out support coverage for the holiday period.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The company holiday calendar is out. The office is closed on Christmas Day, Boxing Day, and New Year's Day.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: And the shutdown week between Christmas and New Year applies to everyone except support and on-call.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Right. So we need coverage on the twenty-ninth, thirtieth, and thirty-first.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Volume last year in that week was about forty percent of normal.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: So two agents per shift should be enough.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's do a sign-up sheet and give priority to people who covered last year.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Should we turn on the holiday autoresponder?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Yes, with expected response times and a link to the status page.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I'll draft the autoresponder text today.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: And for public holidays in other regions, the US team covers Australia Day for us.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: We cover the US on Thanksgiving, same as last year.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. Escalation path during the shutdown?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Same on-call rotation as usual, the schedule is already in the paging tool.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay. Let's post the sign-up sheet tomorrow and close it by Friday.

notes: Hard negative: public holiday schedule discussion.
